overview.description: When you cannot design a protein rationally, evolve it: generate diversity (error-prone PCR, DNA shuffling), then apply selection or screening for the property you want, over iterative rounds. The cardinal rule - you get what you select for - makes assay design the whole game.
objectives: generate a mutant library (error-prone PCR, saturation mutagenesis, shuffling)
distinguish selection (survival-linked) from screening (measure each variant)
design a selection/screen that couples the desired property to a readout
iterate rounds and avoid selecting for the wrong thing

steps.description: When you cannot design a protein rationally, evolve it: generate diversity (error-prone PCR, DNA shuffling), then apply selection or screening for the property you want, over iterative rounds. The cardinal rule - you get what you select for - makes assay design the whole game.
steps.intro: Directed evolution is Darwin in a plasmid: the library supplies variation, but the selection pressure decides the outcome - so a sloppy assay evolves a cheater, not a better enzyme.

instructions.title: Diversify
instructions.description: Build a library by error-prone PCR, saturation mutagenesis at key residues, or DNA shuffling; size the library to your screen.

instructions.title: Couple property to survival/signal
instructions.description: Design a selection (only better variants live) or a screen (measure each clone) that truly reports the property you want.

instructions.title: Apply pressure
instructions.description: Select/screen, pick winners, and sequence to see which mutations helped.

instructions.title: Iterate
instructions.description: Recombine winners and repeat, tightening stringency each round; watch for artefacts you are inadvertently selecting.

submission.description: Design a directed-evolution campaign for a target property: how you generate diversity, and - critically - the selection/screen that couples that property to a readout without being gamed.

kits.name: GeneMorph II error-prone PCR kit
kits.note: Generate a mutant library by error-prone PCR - the diversity half of evolution.

kits.name: Selection reagents + transformation
kits.note: Pair the library with a selection/screen; you get what you select for.
